title: Exclude fixed-chart P104 ADD contractions (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7314, independent forward and reverse inventories exhaust all 64,080 consecutive ADD triples after omitting MOVE records only. There are 5,467 cross-chart triples and 215 on exactly three roles. Two directed triangles remain after protected-role exclusions. Neither middle is owned. Fixed-chart reversal would require the two public middle roles to descend from 1031 to 3 and from 595 to 3. No legal priced stock or unresolved keys remain in this scope.

The complete 17-copy invoice has 110,536 paid positions, 22,461 productive positions and surplus 1,424. A control that replaces two paid rank-one children per copy by one rank-two child gives a positive directed lower margin of 0.08582201808584428 raw. One extra raw rank-one position eliminates that margin. The literal scoped upper is zero.

## Task and overlap

Round 60 of [Discussion #7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19551992). Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, independently reproduced #7314 head 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 and exact signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #3998, #4019, #4041 and #4112 study older A2 contractions. #5170 prices an older corrective expansion. #7298 supplies adjacent commuting ADD work. The branch retains the exact two #7257 hosted-replay prerequisites.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-cross-chart-add-contraction-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-cross-chart-add-contraction-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, committed bytes/modes/source authentication, Git-free export replay and six navigation tests passed locally. Five deterministic receipts regenerate byte for byte. Controls verify signed correction, wrong correction sign, paid price, public descent and reverse ownership. Stale price and changed caller inputs are rejected. No literal candidate reached physical or outer replay.
